subject: Discovery recap + suggested next step for ZenBridge
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Lee <sophia@zenbridge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 15:22 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + suggested next step for ZenBridge

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a suggested next step so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: add contextual, agent-style assistance inside ZenBridge’s customer portal to reduce triage time and deflection tickets by ~20%.
- Data and security: internal product logs + post-auth customer metadata only; SOC2 controls required.
- Success metric: time-to-resolution and NPS on support flows.

Recommended pilot
- 4-week technical POC running on Redwood Private (VPC) with a small subset of endpoints (support webchat + ticket summarization).
- Scope: 50k tokens/day peak, 2 models (generation + embeddings), simple routing/fallback policy.
- Deliverables: integration checklist, performance baseline, and a short doc with cost/latency profile.

Open questions for you
1) Is the pilot scope aligned with your internal priorities?
2) Any non-negotiable security controls beyond SOC2/KMS we should plan for?
3) Who else from your team should be involved on the infra/legal side?

Next step
If that looks reasonable, can we lock a 20-minute slot next week to finalize the pilot scope and timeline? I’ve attached a short deck that summarizes the plan and integration touchpoints.

Attachment: ZenBridge-discovery-deck.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Thanks — I’ll follow up if I don’t hear back early next week.

Best,
Ethan Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ethan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
https://redwood.com

Hi Ethan —

Apologies for the delay — we’ve been validating priorities. Two quick things from our side: 

1) Timeline: leadership is aiming for a decision by the end of June, so a May start for a pilot could work.
2) Pricing: can you share a ballpark range for a pilot that matches the scope you suggested (4-week POC, ~50k tokens/day)? We need a rough number to set expectations with procurement.

Also: happy to include our infra lead on the next call — can you send a short 1–2 slide summary of the pilot plan for them to review?

What we’ll send you now
- 1–2 slide summary of the pilot plan (attached).
- Short pricing brief with assumptions and optional add-ons (attachment).

Attachments: pilot-pricing-brief.pdf (PDF, 0.6MB), ZenBridge-pilot-summary-2p.pdf (PDF, 0.2MB)

Next step
- Can you share 2 windows next week for a 20-minute call that includes your infra lead? Here’s a short scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood/20min

If it’s easier, reply with the name/email of the infra lead and I’ll loop them in directly.

Best,
